name: ComfyUI — ALL in ONE MiniMax H3 (one node, every mode)
description: ComfyUI preloaded with MiniMax H3 (open-weights, int8) behind a single node that replaces the graph entirely: pick a mode in the tab bar, fill the boxes, press Generate, and the node builds the real workflow and queues it for you. Six modes run here — T2V (text to video with native voice, room tone and music in the same forward pass), I2V (animate a start frame, optionally morphing to an end frame), R2V (reference images, video or audio drive the clip), Keyframes (pin stills at chosen frame positions), Extend (continue an existing clip) and Chain (multi-clip continuation through H3 Motion Context, which hands the latent path forward instead of re-encoding a file). Image, Audio Drive and the upscale hooks are present in the tab bar but deliberately not installed: Image mode makes stills rather than video — I2V is the image-to-video one — and wants 12.9 GB of prompt models a video bundle has no other use for; Audio Drive's pack compiles llama-cpp-python and pulls voxcpm, demucs and torchcodec on every launch, and RTX Video Super Resolution needs a consumer RTX card rather than a data-centre GPU. Selecting either reports a missing node rather than failing a paid Run halfway. Prompts take three labelled sections in a fixed order — integrated_multimodal_description (style, subject, setting, the action start to finish), overall_soundscape (ambience and physical sounds) and non_diegetic_music — with dialogue written inline as (S1) <character> speaks: <d>[English] line</d>, and the node's Discover tab ships fill-in templates per mode so none of that has to be memorised. The Quality dropdown offers three presets and all three work unconfigured: Turbo (6 steps with a distillation LoRA, downloaded and preselected because the pack ships its speed_lora setting empty and would otherwise render six undistilled steps), Balanced (30 steps with SolAttn sparse attention, the default) and Native (30 steps, no accelerator). Speed and High Quality are removed on launch rather than shipped degraded: Speed needs the H3 Cache node, which calls a function ComfyUI core removed in August 2026 and which patches the model at import so that merely installing it fails every generation, and High Quality needs SageAttention kernels absent from this image. Both would otherwise sit in the dropdown as a slower Balanced and a slower Native under names promising the opposite, and one wrong click costs a paid Run; nothing is lost on output either way, since SolAttn and Sage are quantized-attention throughput trades rather than quality knobs. The launch script also adds five vertical resolution presets — 352x608, 480x864, 544x960, 576x1024 (exact 9:16) and 768x1344 — to the pack's landscape-only list, since vertical short-form is what this is for. Weights are 59.8 GB (two 19.5 GB diffusion models, since the mode tabs switch between FL2VA and Ref2VA freely, plus the 14.6 GB Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder and 5.5 GB of video and audio VAEs, plus a 0.73 GB Turbo LoRA); only one diffusion model is resident per generation. Select a persistent-storage bucket on launch: it holds ComfyUI's whole base directory, so those 59.8 GB download once instead of on every launch, and the node's history, favourites and settings come back on the next launch with the same bucket. Clips are saved flat to the bucket root as h3_00001_.mp4, h3_00002_.mp4, where the storage API's listFiles (top-level files only) can find them; Chain is the exception and writes into chain/<session>/, so pull those from the node's Library tab before stopping. Without a bucket everything lands in /tmp and is discarded on stop. Needs a CUDA GPU; 48 GB+ holds a generation comfortably and 24 GB runs it at a lower resolution with offloading.

workflows.name: ALL in ONE — pick a mode, press Generate
workflows.description: One canvas, one node. The tab bar switches between T2V, I2V, R2V, Keyframes, Extend and Chain; the node assembles the matching H3 graph and queues it, so there is nothing to wire and no second workflow to switch to. Two notes flank it: how to write the three prompt sections and which quality presets are installed, and what the 59.1 GB of weights are. Clips land in the bucket root as h3_00001_.mp4.

requiredResources.description: One CUDA GPU. A generation holds one diffusion model (19.5 GB), the text encoder (14.6 GB) and both VAEs (5.5 GB) — about 40 GB — so a 48 GB card runs it with room for activations and an 80 GB card runs it at full resolution without offloading. 24 GB works at the lower resolution presets, with ComfyUI paging the text encoder out between passes. Don't set CLI_ARGS yourself: the launch script measures the card against the 59.1 GB actually downloaded and adds --highvram only when VRAM covers it with 3/2 headroom, which on this weight set means it declines the flag on anything below ~90 GB rather than pinning more than the card can back. Ask for one card and not two: core ComfyUI has no tensor parallelism, a single sampling pass runs on one device, and H3 is CFG-distilled so there is no second conditioning branch to hand a second card. A second GPU would be billed while idle.
